headline: Pearson (LSE:PSON) Stock Gets Fair Value Bump As Analysts Weigh Execution And Upside
summary: Pearson’s fair value estimate has been adjusted from £11.83 to about £12.24, reflecting updated assumptions in recent analyst research. This aligns with commentary that acknowledges Pearson’s progress on execution, while also questioning how much upside remains after the share price move and current guidance. As you read on, you will see how these shifting views contribute to the evolving narrative around growth, margins, and what might already be reflected in the stock’s valuation. Analyst...

headline: Morgan Stanley Real Estate Investing Announces Acquisition of French Logistics Portfolio of Five Assets
summary: PARIS, July 24, 2026--Morgan Stanley Investment Management, through investment funds managed by Morgan Stanley Real Estate Investing (MSREI), announced today the acquisition of a portfolio of five French logistics assets. The fully leased portfolio totals approximately 160,000 square meters across established French logistics markets in Paris, Lille, Bordeaux, Nîmes and Tours.
